items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station or craft at Tinker's Workbench

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Place any decoration in your Shelter using the build menu

items.title: Collect a Teddy Bear
items.detail: Several spawn on a ledge northeast of Knife Edge; use grenades to knock them down

items.title: Eat a Cooked Meal
items.detail: Cook at any cooking station or buy from Mr. Waiter/Ms. Waitress at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Kill a Festive Scorched
items.detail: Available only during Holiday Scorched event; they wear holiday costumes and spawn where regular Scorched do

items.title: Kill a Honey Beast
items.detail: Fast travel to Middle Mountain Pitstop for reliable spawns

items.title: Kill a Radhog
items.detail: Several spawn southwest of Ash Cave fast travel point near a windmill

items.title: Destroy Robots with an Energy Weapon
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has dependable robot spawns; use Laser Rifles, Plasma Guns, Tesla Rifles, or Gauss weapons

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies killed with energy weapons

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P. if you have one placed

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: RobCo Research Center offers dependable spawns for Protectrons, Eyebots, Assaultrons, and other robot types

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Gather from Silva Homestead or plant vegetables at your C.A.M.P. to harvest on demand

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Only appears as uninvited guest at Head Hunt events during Slasher seasonal event final stage

items.title: Sell Pumpkin Pie to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Buy from Mr. Waiter/Ms. Waitress at Whitespring Resort or find one at Pumpkin House kitchen table

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Any weapon works; Whitespring Resort has multiple vendors or craft inexpensive grenades to sell

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to another player's C.A.M.P. marked with red radiation symbol and enter their Shelter

events.name: Invaders from Beyond
events.description: Alien-themed event running through mid-November with special rewards available.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-costumed Scorched enemies spawn worldwide offering seasonal rewards and gifts.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 8)
events.description: Minerva offers discounted plans including Gauss weapons, Secret Service armor, and Thorn armor pieces.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Double rewards in Daily Ops with new and seasonal rewards plus bonus gold gains.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events spawn with mutations offering rewards from special Mutated Packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Double XP rates across all activities for faster leveling and Scoreboard progression.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) / Season 27 Start
events.description: Major update introducing World Pets system and beginning Season 27 You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L.
